Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, data As Worksheet, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, s As String, v As String
    Dim i As Long, row As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set data = wb.Worksheets(1)
    data.Range("A1:E1").Value = Array("Region", "Kind", "Year", "Amount", "Note")
    row = Array(Array("East", "A", 2020, 1, "n"), Array("East", "B", 2021, 2, "n"), Array("West", "A", 2020, 4, "m"), Array("West", "B", 2021, 8, "m"), Array("North", "A", 2021, 16, "m"))
    For i = 0 To 4: data.Range("A" & i + 2).Resize(1, 5).Value = row(i): Next
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, data.Range("A1:E6")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("A5"), "P")
    pt.PivotFields("Region").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.PivotFields("Kind").Orientation = xlColumnField
    pt.PivotFields("Year").Orientation = xlPageField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("Amount"), "Total", xlSum
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 1
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotItems("East").Visible = False
    Case 2
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionEquals, , "East"
    Case 3
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, , "E"
    Case 4
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlTopCount, pt.DataFields(1), 1
    Case 5
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlValueIsGreaterThan, pt.DataFields(1), 5
    Case 6
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionEquals, , "East": pt.PivotFields("Kind").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionEquals, , "A"
    Case 7
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionEquals, , "East": pt.ClearAllFilters
    Case 8
        pt.PivotFields("Year").ClearAllFilters: pt.PivotFields("Year").CurrentPage = "2020"
    Case 9
        pt.PivotFields("Year").EnableMultiplePageItems = True: pt.PivotFields("Year").PivotItems("2021").Visible = False
    Case 10
        pt.PivotFields("Year").ClearAllFilters: pt.PivotFields("Year").AddPageItem "2020"
    Case 11
        pt.PivotFields("Year").ClearAllFilters: pt.PivotFields("Year").AddPageItem "2020": pt.PivotFields("Year").AddPageItem "2021"
    Case 12
        pt.PivotFields("Year").ClearAllFilters: pt.PivotFields("Year").AddPageItem "2020", True
    Case 13
        pt.PivotFields("Year").AddPageItem "1999"
    Case 14
        pt.PivotFields("Region").AddPageItem "East"
    Case 15
        pt.PivotFields("Region").AllItemsVisible = True
    Case 16
        pt.PivotFields("Region").ShowingInAxis = False
    Case 17
        pt.PivotFields("Region").ShowingInAxis = True
    Case 18
        pt.PivotFields("Note").Orientation = xlRowField
    Case 19
        pt.PivotFields("Region").Orientation = xlHidden
    Case 20
        pt.PivotFields("Kind").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionEquals, , "A": pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionEquals, , "East"
    Case 21
        pt.RefreshTable
    Case 22
        pt.PivotCache.Refresh
    End Select
    s = "ok"
Measured:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.ActiveFilters)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters(1).FilterType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters(1).Description
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.ActiveFilters(1).Application)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters(1).Active
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters(1).PivotField.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters(1).IsMemberPropertyFilter
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.ActiveFilters(1).Value1
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Region").AllItemsVisible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Kind").AllItemsVisible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Year").AllItemsVisible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Amount").AllItemsVisible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Note").AllItemsVisible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Region").ShowingInAxis
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Kind").ShowingInAxis
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Year").ShowingInAxis
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Amount").ShowingInAxis
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Note").ShowingInAxis
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.DataFields(1).ShowingInAxis
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.PivotFields("Region").ChildItems)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Region").ChildItems.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Year").PageRangeCells
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PageRangeCells.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PageRange.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.RefreshName = Application.UserName
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Int(pt.RefreshDate) = Date
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotCache.RefreshName = Application.UserName
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Int(pt.PivotCache.RefreshDate) = Date
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotCache.MemoryUsed > 0
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Region").MemoryUsed > 0
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.PivotRowAxis)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.PivotColumnAxis)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.PivotFormulas)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFormulas.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(ws.Range("B7").PivotCell.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("B7").PivotCell.CellChanged
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("B7").PivotCell.DataSourceValue
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("B7").PivotCell.ServerActions.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A7").PivotCell.CellChanged
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A7").PivotCell.DataSourceValue
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.TableRange1.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.TableRange2.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("B1").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & Replace(v, ",", ";")
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 22
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
